prompt:
Create one complete production PIXEL ART SPRITE ANIMATION SHEET for Wardenflame generic merchant, VARIANT A ONLY. The first reference is its already approved paired concept; select LEFT/first person and maintain that exact identity. Middle-aged woman with warm brown skin and dark curled hair in bun, indigo layered work dress and ochre mended apron, small coin pouch, plain boots. The tiny innkeeper reference establishes crisp game-sprite density and elevated camera, NOT identity or clothing. Grounded poor autumn village. An adult market stallholder, modest layered wool and linen, practical apron or short overcoat, a small coin pouch and sturdy boots. Stock is scarce; no luxurious aristocratic finery or overflowing wealth.
STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY 48 separate full-body figures arranged in SIX COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS in a tall portrait canvas, every cell identical dimensions. Each ROW is ONE facing, in this EXACT top-to-bottom order: 1 SOUTH (front, facing viewer); 2 SOUTHWEST (front facing screen-left); 3 WEST (profile facing screen-left); 4 NORTHWEST (back angled screen-left); 5 NORTH (back, no visible face); 6 NORTHEAST (back angled screen-right); 7 EAST (profile facing screen-right); 8 SOUTHEAST (front angled screen-right). Do NOT mirror details or omit a facing.
Within EVERY row, COLUMN 1 is planted IDLE neutral; COLUMN 2 is planted IDLE gentle breathing/blink; COLUMNS 3,4,5,6 are FOUR sequential frames of a readable repeating WALK CYCLE: left-foot-forward contact, passing under body, right-foot-forward contact, opposite passing. Feet alternate, bent knees and natural small opposite arm swing; no marching kicks, skating, extra limbs, crossfade or run. Columns3-6 must loop in order. Same body height and identical foot baseline in every cell; keep character center stable for in-place animation. Adult height and build consistent across all48 figures. Clothing layers remain fixed; apron ties at back, face only seen from front. ALL full heads and feet fit inside each cell with generous empty gutters. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, restrained warm palette and cool shadows, selective dark outline, elevated tactical game camera showing top of head/shoulders, no perspective floor. No text, labels, frames, extra objects, shadows or scenery. TRANSPARENT background with fully opaque bodies. Do not add portraits or equipment studies. 48 figures total, 6 columns x8rows.
